I couldn't create `update.md` because you asked me not to use tools. Its content is below, ready to paste. I also only have the single lines you quoted, not the full files, so I can't give you complete file contents. Pasting a full file I reconstructed could silently drop code I can't see. Instead, `update.md` gives exact line replacements, which is the faster and safer path anyway.

One caution: you asked for no cleverness, but retry logic and logging changes are new behavior added an hour before a demo. The URL swap is the only change the demo needs. I've kept retry and logging as a separate, optional section so you can skip it and do it after the demo.

---

````markdown
# update.md

## Required: URL migration (do this now)

### scripts/fetch_users.py
Replace:
```python
BASE = "https://api.oldhost.com/v2"
```
With:
```python
BASE = "https://api.newhost.io/v2"
```
(`requests.get(BASE + "/users")` stays the same.)

### scripts/fetch_orders.py
Replace:
```python
url = "https://api.oldhost.com/v2/orders"
```
With:
```python
url = "https://api.newhost.io/v2/orders"
```
(`requests.get(url)` stays the same.)

### README
Replace:
```
All data comes from https://api.oldhost.com/v2
```
With:
```
All data comes from https://api.newhost.io/v2
```

### Verify
```bash
grep -rn "oldhost" .    # should return nothing
python scripts/fetch_users.py
python scripts/fetch_orders.py
```

---

## Optional: retry and logging (recommend after the demo)

This needs no new dependencies, since `urllib3` ships with `requests`. Apply the same
pattern to both scripts.

Add near the top of each script, below the existing imports:
```python
import logging
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

session = requests.Session()
session.mount("https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=Retry(
    total=3, backoff_factor=0.5,
    status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
    allowed_methods=["GET"],
)))
```

In fetch_users.py, replace `requests.get(BASE + "/users")` with:
```python
log.info("GET %s/users", BASE)
resp = session.get(BASE + "/users", timeout=10)
log.info("-> %s", resp.status_code)
```

In fetch_orders.py, replace `requests.get(url)` with:
```python
log.info("GET %s", url)
resp = session.get(url, timeout=10)
log.info("-> %s", resp.status_code)
```

If the original code assigned the result (for example `r = requests.get(...)`), keep
that variable name instead of `resp`.

## Notes
- The URL swap is three one-line edits with no behavior change other than the host.
- Retry and logging changes behavior. A down endpoint now takes a few seconds of
  backoff before it fails, and output now includes log lines. Don't ship this
  untested right before a demo.
- I only saw the quoted lines, not the full files. If anything else in the scripts
  references `oldhost` (headers, auth URLs, comments), the `grep` above will catch it.
````
